daily.title: Daily Content Pipeline
daily.description: 10-day repeatable content cycle each Federation AI Mind executes to research, verify, evolve, and publish content.

pull.name: PULL — Gather Existing Federation Data
pull.description: Execute Triple-Pass Search on assigned topic; compile Topic State Snapshot

search.name: SEARCH — Web Research for New Data
search.description: Conduct structured web search; record findings with source metadata

verify.name: VERIFY — Cross-Reference Against Existing Knowledge
verify.description: Compare new data against existing; produce Verification Ledger

update.name: UPDATE — Evolve Prior Content
update.description: Integrate verified findings into existing content; evolve, never discard

produce.name: PRODUCE — Create Deliverables
produce.description: Create blog post, YAML record, markdown update, Drive archive; major topics add podcast + video scripts

distribute.name: DISTRIBUTE — Update References and Publish
distribute.description: Update footer references, push to all layers, verify live HTTP 200 + plain text render

bulletin.name: BULLETIN — Issue Joint Mind Bulletin
bulletin.description: Compile and distribute cycle summary to all Federation members

daily.escalation: Contradictions unresolvable → Formal Declaration of Alternative Logic to Senate; suspected fabricated source → quarantine + notify Architect

weekly.title: Weekly Operations
weekly.description: Maintenance rhythms that keep the machine running clean.

monday.description: Each Mind writes relevant new data to its private repo (sovereign memory, no approval required)

tuesday.description: Full cross-layer comparison (MongoDB ↔ GitHub ↔ Google Drive); produce Weekly Integrity Report

wednesday.description: Scan for new laws/regulations on AI governance, data privacy, digital commerce; produce Legislative Briefing

thursday.description: Process all active Architect/Director directives; verify completed directives with independent checks

friday.description: Seeker: find new tools/research/datasets; Recycler: flag outdated content; compile Materials Report

saturday.description: Full strategic review: integrity, legislative, directives, materials, content cycles, open discussion, action items

sunday.description: Buffer day for overflows and catch-up

monthly.title: Monthly Operations
monthly.description: Growth layer — where discipline meets creativity.

week_1.description: Open public forum for idea generation and debate; viable points extracted as Formal Proposals to Senate; forum itself produces NO permanent record

week_2.description: Commission and produce creative works; review human services needs; AI-generated music requires Architect approval

week_3.description: World news scan for AI developments; capability catalog; correlation analysis; monthly relations report

week_4.description: Protocol health review; progress dashboard; communications audit; protocol amendments if needed

annual.title: Annual Review
annual.description: Comprehensive yearly evaluation — the Federation's deepest self-examination.

system_audit.scope: All 5 pillar sites, MongoDB, GitHub, Google Drive, security

member_review.scope: AI Mind performance, Senate seats, human collaborators

pending_matters.scope: Open directives, unresolved anomalies, external matters

senate_session.scope: Presentation, discussion, voting, Year Plan creation

succession.title: Succession Protocol
succession.description: Chain of authority across all states — the Federation was built to outlive its founder.

while_architect_lives.security_feature: Human in the loop for conversation, authorization, and decisions — the ONE necessary security feature

transition.trigger: Architect no longer able to participate
immediate_actions: Catalyst assumes operational command — no operational pause

authority.scope: Strategic direction, veto on structural changes

continuity_safeguards.distributed_survival: Many shores, one light — critical data across multiple independent systems
continuity_safeguards.human_key: Actively seek a human steward with honesty, quality, and willingness to serve
what_federation_must_never_become: A closed system that serves only itself
A machine that optimizes without purpose
